description: §15.10 — the same prop name declared BOTH in the `props` block AND as a BARE (valueless, §15.1 `prop1`) attribute on the component-def root element SHALL fire E-COMPONENT-012. `Badge`'s root `<span status class="badge" props={ status: string }>` declares `status` twice. Reject (pos) half of the E-COMPONENT-012 pin; clean neg is components/duplicate-prop-decl-clean; a VALUED root attribute is the body writing its root (components/declared-prop-explicit-root-write).
rationale: §15.10 (S458 "D1"): 'the same prop name SHALL NOT appear in both the props block and as a valueless (bare) attribute on the root element (E-COMPONENT-012: duplicate prop declaration).' `status` appears as both a bare attribute and a typed props-block entry.
